notes.title: Announcement: About the Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone (assuming anyone sees this :)



To those who wishlisted, you might have seen that the game was initially set to be released on June 27th, 2025. That was indeed my original plan. I wanted to put out a demo for the next fest and then release the game right after, but the demo page didn't come out in time, so I gave up on that. Then the summer sale started, and the store page is now filled with big titles. I don't think it would be a good idea to release my tiny game at this moment if I want it to reach any audience at all.



Therefore, I decide to delay the actual date of release to July 12th, right after the summer sale is over, and I also get to work on the game a bit more.



Sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding!



Truth Facer Games
